name: Wit of the Staggering Avalanche
body:
School evocation [force]; Level: jester 8

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Touch
Target: Creature touched
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: none; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target takes 3d8 points of force damage +1 point per caster level, and you push the target 20 feet.

Until the end of combat, you are immune to involuntary movement.
